description: C3-symmetric convex 15-gon in which every vertex has exactly three other vertices at one common distance (K3 everywhere, radius depends on the vertex). Found by c3_symmetric_search.py (K=3, M=5, seed 11, SEP 0.15, 100 restarts); coordinates rounded to 5 decimals; verify_multiplicity.py with tolerance 1e-4 reports min_cross 4.97e-3, min_sep 0.1502, all multiplicities 3. The three points at radius 1 (indices 0, 5, 10) form the Moser triangle of the minimum enclosing circle; all other points are strictly inside (max radius 0.97602); each closed cap has 6 points, so this configuration lies in the route-B tail shape (all caps at least 6) of the P97 spine with K3 in place of K4.
